plugins.name: dev-pdca
plugins.description: Five skills forming a PDCA loop: planner (plan before code), tasker (checkable changes with evidence), bugfixer (reproduce, prove the cause, fix, guard), auditor (evidence-backed audits), evolver (turn verified lessons into guards and ledger records); plus explainer (read-only, plain-language explanations of the codebase with file paths).

plugins.name: gamesmith
plugins.description: A staged workflow for building casual mini games (WeChat, Douyin and similar platforms): compliance first, feel prototype, engine-free core with config tables, level pipeline with a chunk solver and generator, code-drawn atlases, platform build, playtest loop, launch checklist and post-launch iteration. Ships runnable skeletons for the validator, solver and preview.

plugins.name: design-to-dev
plugins.description: For designers: screenshots, Figma links, brand guides or a text idea become a clickable prototype (plain HTML/CSS/JS, fake data, key states, bundled fonts), design tokens (CSS + W3C JSON) and HANDOFF.md, with every item marked Fixed, Indicative or TBD, and a visual direction locked before styling.
